svg.title: Unlimited spectrum per speed
svg.desc: The power spectrum of random data at 1, 3, 6, 12 and 25 bytes per second with their occupied bands, against the 2.4 kHz and 1.8 kHz SSB filters.
svg.text: Spectrum per speed against SSB filters (spec 1.3)
Welch power spectrum of 64 random bytes from the Encoder at 8000 Hz, 1500 Hz pitch; each curve to its own peak. Bars: the occupied band (99 % of the power).
